name: DefectsLiabilityWarrantyManager
tagline: Close out the defects liability period and never miss a warranty – defects, callbacks and expiries in one app.
description: Complete post-handover defects and warranty module for Power Apps and Power Pages: log defects and warranty claims with priority SLAs, notify contractors, track rectification, independent verification and close-out with callbacks and disputes, check DLP / warranty / out-of-cover on every defect, keep a warranty register per system with expiry alerts and pre-expiry inspection requests, and watch contractor performance and back-charge exposure.
features: Priority SLAs and due dates with overdue and due-soon flags
Notify → attend → rectify → verify & close workflow with disputes
Failed verification and re-opened defects counted as callbacks
DLP / warranty / out-of-cover check on every defect
Warranty register per system with expiry timeline and alerts
Contractor performance and open back-charge exposure
Bulk notify / rectify / close / due date, reminder, summary and inspection texts
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
